**Interest expense:** It includes amortization of capitalized debt issuance costs, which is offset by amortization of debt premium and by interest income earned on cash and cash equivalents [1]. It excludes interest incurred during construction projects to build, upgrade, or remodel certain facilities. That interest is capitalized to property and equipment and depreciated over the assets' estimated useful lives [2].

**Other (income) expense, net:** It includes changes in fair value on beneficial interests in securitizations, purchase price adjustment receivables, and fair value adjustments related to the Root Warrants. It also includes other general expenses such as gains or losses from disposals of long-lived assets [3].

**New for 2023:** During the year ended December 31, 2023, other (income) expense, net also includes expense related to the recognition of the Tax Receivable Agreement reserve [4].
